methods.title: What three sets of numbers cover
methods.summary: Each ticket carries three separate six-number sets, and each is compared with the same drawing independently.
methods.limitation: Three sets are three chances at the published odds. They do not change how the drawing is conducted.

methods.title: Setting a fixed entertainment budget
methods.summary: Deciding an amount before you play, and treating it as the cost of entertainment, keeps ticket volume in proportion.
methods.limitation: No budget or ticket volume changes the outcome of a drawing.
